title: Birdsong Alphabet
hook: Listen for the source before you name the bird.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one beat with bird effects muted
visualStyle: bright 3D bird storybook, sky blues and leafy greens, anatomically clear friendly birds, clean branches and backgrounds

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child building a listening map without assuming every bird sings
creativeFingerprint.round1Grammar: hand-written acoustic or visual clue; nest explicit non-bird
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: listen/look cue -> recall beat -> target -> safe gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a light flute chirp and one warm ukulele wingbeat after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a light flute chirp and one warm ukulele wingbeat after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Birdsong Alphabet an acoustic field guide: song, call, coo, drumming, silence and non-vocal clues are distinguished instead of forcing every bird into tweeting.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child listens first, then checks bill, habitat and behavior; some targets are heard, some seen, and Nest is evidence rather than a bird.
semanticArc: visual clues and final listening map
